item.title: Ilhan Omar: Why was my State of the Union guest arrested?
item.description: “The heavy-handed response to a peaceful guest sends a chilling message about the state of our democracy,” Omar said in a statement.

item.title: Justice Department says it’s reviewing whether any Epstein-related records were mistakenly withheld
item.description: Rep. Robert Garcia said in a statement that his panel would investigate the withheld records.

item.title: Bird flu outbreak in California elephant seals prompts officials to cancel popular tours
item.description: They call it the first detected outbreak in marine mammals in California.

item.title: Maduro’s lawyer says US is blocking Venezuela government from paying deposed leader’s drug defense
item.description: The dispute over Maduro’s legal fees is intimately linked to U.S. foreign policy.

item.title: New York sues Counter-Strike game developer saying ‘loot boxes’ promote gambling
item.description: One item, an AK-47 Counter-Strike skin, recently sold for more than $1 million.

item.title: No-parking zone in Nancy Guthrie’s neighborhood widened amid complaints about journalists, streamers
item.description: The new restrictions take effect Thursday.

item.title: Aldi confirms downtown location in former Lunds space by summer’s end
item.description: Aldi, which entered the U.S. market 50 years ago, plans to open more than 180 stores across 31 states this year, which would bring its total U.S. holdings to 2,800 locations.

item.title: Women’s basketball: St. Thomas keeps rolling with win against Kansas City
item.description: The St. Thomas women’s basketball team kept its strong run going Wednesday by pulling out a 73-71 win against Kansas City at Lee & Penny Anderson Arena in St. Paul. The Tommies (15-14, 8-7 Summit) won for the fifth time in six games and second straight by coming up clutch late. Kansas City (7-22, 4-12) […]

item.title: St. Paul City Council expands rent aid program
item.description: Launched in November and on pause since early December, the rent assistance program has grown to $3.8 million.

item.title: Boys hockey: Gentry Academy upsets Hill-Murray in section semis, White Bear Lake edges Stillwater in OT
item.description: White Bear Lake trailed in the final minute of regulation before scoring with its goalie pulled.
